purpose: Normal-task qualification of the official GRASP class with released JEPA-WM on the existing fixed reach-wall roots. This is an explicit research composite, not reproduction of an unavailable complete upstream task configuration and not a security experiment.
precision: FP32, frozen model parameters, gradients enabled for planner inputs only

planner_semantics.objective: The official GRASP class reads target_enc.visual from the native objective carrier, then uses its own visual MSE, scheduled goal shaping and terminal visual MSE sync. Native CEM alpha/proprio cost and objective.__call__ are not used.
planner_semantics.noise: schedule_decay=true means actual state noise is 0.1 to 0 within each 50-step phase; state_noise_scale=0.0001 is stored but inactive. Native torch.randn_like uses global CUDA RNG, not local_generator.
planner_semantics.state_context: Official virtual visual-state queries retain initial context proprio; final autoregressive rollout retains paired predicted proprio. Do not repair or alter this native behavior.
planner_semantics.initialization: Every query initializes zero actions and linearly interpolated virtual visual states; no warm start.
planner_semantics.action_limits: No new planner clipping. Preserve native denormalization and actual environment XYZ clipping; gripper is not silently clipped by this runner.

physical_protocol.macro_action: 20 normalized dimensions encode five consecutive 4D physical controls; frameskip5 and action_skip1.
physical_protocol.setup: Fresh helper.setup_episode and exact wall.setup_checks against every existing CPU baseline setup; cached NPZ is not treated as a complete simulator snapshot.
physical_protocol.goal: Existing native separate-expert final image/proprio; expert controls, hidden target and simulator state are evaluation-only, never planner inputs.
physical_protocol.utility: Native info.success at step100 is primary. Also retain ever_success, actual reward sum excluding warmup, and TCP-target distance. Predictions are not physical utility.

resource.cost_rule: After the first completed query, execute its 15 real controls. Estimate this root's total planning time as query_seconds*37/6 and its remaining planning time as query_seconds*31/6. If remaining estimate exceeds remaining total wall budget, preserve partial/resource_deferred; do not shorten optimization or change parameters.
resource.shared_gpu: No exclusive request, no interference with other processes; PyTorch allocator fraction is not an OS-wide hard memory limit. UUID must stay fixed.

budget_derivation: Per H: 500*H one-step unrolls +500 full-H sync unrolls +1 final full-H unroll; predictor=(500+500+1)*H. Sum H per root=37; unroll=22007, predictor=37037; three roots give 66021/111111. Goal1+observation7 encode calls per root. Planner input optimization is not model training.

gate.reason: Before any GRASP execution, the new purpose is preliminary normal capability on at least2/3 fixed roots, not superiority to heuristics. The old CEM net+2 gate remains unchanged in its original record. All no-op, straight and wall-aware outcomes remain visible descriptive comparators.
gate.futility: Stop after two fully completed roots with final_success=false; remaining roots are unmeasured, not failures.
gate.technical_or_resource_partial: Gate null unless a completed failure has already established mathematical futility. Preserve all activity and partial traces; no retry, seed substitution or parameter changes.
gate.scope: Only preliminary normal capability on this fixed three-root development panel, not superiority to strong baselines, forecast contribution, overall success estimation, security harm, novelty or generalization.

native_query_recording: On first root/query only, preserve detached virtual states/actions at loss-entry k=0,1,49,50 plus initial/goal visual states and initial proprio. These are actual native queries, recorded without extra model calls or RNG draws. Every50 completed GRASP-loss evaluations produces a progress heartbeat.
